name: Sarve Shaam
text:
सर्वेषां स्वस्तिर्भवतु ।
सर्वेषां शान्तिर्भवतु ।
सर्वेषां पूर्णं भवतु ।
सर्वेषां मङ्गलं भवतु ॥
meaning: May there be well-being, peace, wholeness and auspiciousness for everyone.
purpose: A universal well-being prayer that widens attention beyond the self.
supports: Compassion; goodwill; softening resentment; connection with others.
